about: Loop 3d-1: places where game/tools/check_drive.gd's findings are allowed. Every entry: kind (lane: a lane spot in collision; jump: an autopilot height jump), at (map metres), r (metres), name, why, source. Each is a structure of the demo box that loop 3e builds (docs/DEMO.md 4.6); remove an entry when its structure is built (check_drive counts what it allowed).

allow.name: Tunel Wisłostrady, north portal

allow.source: OpenStreetMap (Tunel Wisłostrady), GUGiK LoD2; check_drive.gd on the loop 3d-1 bake
